description: Synthetic freight yard. Crate C-7 is placed by two accepted claims on the functional location slot (located-at, key role located): the system records it at dock A from T2 until superseded, and a yard clerk records it at bay 3 from T4 until superseded, accepted by the system. A scan drone records it at gate 2 from T5 until superseded; nobody reviews that claim, so it is unreviewed for the system. From T4 on the two accepted places are rival values of one slot key; before T4 only dock A is claimed.
